title: SCRUBBED PINE & BLACKWOOD COUN...
reason: Solid 5ft farmhouse kitchen table in pine and hardwood, practical and sought after locally, plain but sound.
findings: Rectangular farmhouse table with a scrubbed pale softwood plank top with moulded edge, a coarse open-grained frieze and four turned legs with ring turnings and bun feet. Legs and frieze look like a rift-sawn open-grained hardwood (grain shows ray fleck like oak), so the blackwood claim is plausible but not certain. Old marker or pencil '11' on the frieze. No maker's stamp seen.
condition: Top has patchy orange staining, knocks and water marks from scrubbing; edges slightly worn; legs look solid, no breaks seen; underside and joints not shown.
rescore_note: Sound 5ft country table, scrubbed softwood top on turned hardwood legs (blackwood plausible but unproven, could be oak or silky oak); useful but plain, no maker, stained and knocked top, about the $80-200 band. No comps seen, judgement only.
